(rule!
 ;; SWAP the colors of the two objects (left object <-> right object).
 (let* ((comps (sort (objects g 0) (lambda (a b) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))
        (a (first comps))
        (b (second comps)))
   (paint-cells (paint-cells g (obj-cells a) (obj-color b))
                (obj-cells b) (obj-color a))))
